parameters.notes: Selects the context the research prompt sends. website, source, vertical, client_id and lead_pool were missing, so they could not have reached Claude however the prompt was written.

nodes.name: Get New Leads
nodes.notes: Pilot scoping: tenant leads only. Without lead_pool the schedule would enrich the 891 house leads sitting in New Lead as well, which is the bulk research that was ruled out. Remove this filter to let the house pool back in.

nodes.name: Claude Research Lead
nodes.notes: Body comes from Build Research Prompt. It was an inline expression with literal newlines inside a JS string literal, which never evaluated, so no usable body was ever sent.

nodes.name: Parse Claude Response
nodes.notes: Only marks Researched when a non-empty summary actually exists. Marking it unconditionally is what fed 1,373 unresearched leads to the scorer.

nodes.name: Apollo Enrichment (fallback on fail)
nodes.notes: Apollo enrichment: activates when APOLLO_API_KEY is configured in n8n credentials. Until then, the sub-workflow's Apollo HTTP nodes fail auth; continueOnFail + continueRegularOutput routes execution straight to the Claude Research Lead step as a fallback.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: 'CLX-Lead-Research-v2', node_name: 'Claude Research Lead', error_code: 'RESEARCH_EMPTY', error_message: ($json._diagnostic || 'no summary produced'), severity: 'high', category: 'research', input_data: { lead_id: $json.id, model_replied: $json._model_replied, http_hint: $json._http_hint, wf_build: $json._wf_build, transport: ($json._transport || null), lead_status_written: $json.lead_status } }) }}

nodes.name: Log Research Failure
nodes.notes: scan_errors is the table discovery already uses. A research failure now answers the same query as every other failure, instead of being invisible.

nodes.name: Build Research Prompt
nodes.notes: The first version told the model to return INSUFFICIENT_DATA unless it could say something specific about the named company. With no browsing it never can, so every lead came back insufficient. Reasoning from supplied attributes to a market position is legitimate research; inventing funding, hiring or awards is not. The rule now separates those two rather than banning both.
